# Meta-Action Dataset

This folder saves generated scenario outcomes for SEAN 2.0 meta-action experiments.

## Contents

* scenario\_configs.csv: scenario name, robot meta-action, social-force parameter setting, changed parameter values, parameter source, and trajectory file path.
* meta\_action\_outcome\_summary.csv: extracted outcome features for each generated run.
* rajectories/: per-timestep trajectory and feature logs generated by MetaActionFeatureLogger.
* `automated\_runner\_summary.csv`: extracted feature summary from the automated runner test.
* `trajectories/meta\_features\_auto\_default\_20260615\_144153.csv`: combined automated-run trajectory log containing all six run labels.



## Scenario Setup

* Unity scene: Outdoor / CrossPath
* Robot meta-action: fixed meta-action across all runs
* Goal definition: goal is initialized ahead of the robot from its starting pose
* Baseline for pedestrian deviation: default parameter run

## Saved Features

Each trajectory CSV contains per-timestep values including:

* robot position
* pedestrian positions
* distance to goal
* progress along the goal-ahead direction
* current minimum distance to pedestrians
* minimum distance to pedestrians so far
* collision count
* number of pedestrians

The summary CSV contains extracted run-level features:

* minimum distance to pedestrians
* mean pedestrian deviation from default
* maximum pedestrian deviation from default
* progress along the goal-ahead direction
* collision count

## Current Runs

The current dataset contains six runs:

1. default
2. weak\_robot\_repulsion
3. strong\_robot\_repulsion
4. faster\_pedestrians
5. stronger\_social\_force\_A
6. larger\_social\_force\_B

## Parameter Notes

Default social-force parameters:

* DESIRED\_SPEED = 0.6
* MAX\_VEL = 0.6
* A = 500
* B = 0.16
* T = 0.5
* LATERAL\_DAMPENING = 5
* ROBOT\_REPULSION\_DAMPENING\_MIN = 0.5
* ROBOT\_REPULSION\_DAMPENING\_MAX = 1.0

Changed settings:

* weak\_robot\_repulsion: ROBOT\_REPULSION\_DAMPENING\_MIN = 0.1, ROBOT\_REPULSION\_DAMPENING\_MAX = 0.3
* strong\_robot\_repulsion: ROBOT\_REPULSION\_DAMPENING\_MIN = 2.0, ROBOT\_REPULSION\_DAMPENING\_MAX = 3.0
* faster\_pedestrians: DESIRED\_SPEED = 0.9, MAX\_VEL = 0.9
* stronger\_social\_force\_A: A = 2000
* larger\_social\_force\_B: B = 0.32

## Reproducibility Notes

The default values are confirmed from the current Parameters.cs. The weak/strong robot-repulsion values are recorded from the manual run setup because the temporary parameter changes were not committed to Git. Future runs should save the parameter configuration automatically at runtime.

The default run is used as the baseline for pedestrian deviation, so its pedestrian deviation relative to itself is 0.



## Automated Runner Status



An initial automated runner has been added in:



`Assets/Scripts/SEAN/Experiments/MetaActionDatasetRunner.cs`



It automatically applies six social-force parameter settings, sets the robot meta-action, updates the feature logger run label, runs each configuration, and saves the combined trajectory/features log.



The automated runner test generated:



`trajectories/meta\_features\_auto\_default\_20260615\_144153.csv`



This combined CSV contains six run labels:



\- `auto\_default`

\- `auto\_weak\_robot\_repulsion`

\- `auto\_strong\_robot\_repulsion`

\- `auto\_faster\_pedestrians`

\- `auto\_stronger\_social\_force\_A`

\- `auto\_larger\_social\_force\_B`



Current limitation: the final run logs extra rows because the logger continues recording after the runner finishes. This can be cleaned up by disabling logging or stopping Play mode automatically at the end of the runner.





\## Multi-Scenario Automated Runner



A multi-scenario automated runner has been tested. It runs three robot-task scenarios:



\- BusyABNav

\- JoinGroup

\- LeaveGroup



For each scenario, it runs six social-force parameter settings:



\- default

\- weak\_robot\_repulsion

\- strong\_robot\_repulsion

\- faster\_pedestrians

\- stronger\_social\_force\_A

\- larger\_social\_force\_B



This produces 18 automated outcomes in total.



The generated multi-scenario trajectory/features log is saved at:



`trajectories/meta\_features\_multi\_scenario\_auto\_20260616\_144400.csv`



The extracted multi-scenario feature summary is saved at:



`multi\_scenario\_automated\_runner\_summary.csv`



Notes:

\- The initial `TestAuto` rows in the trajectory file can be ignored because they were logged before the automated runner updated the run label.

\- The final run currently has extra rows because the logger continues recording after the runner finishes. This can be cleaned up later by disabling the logger or stopping Play mode automatically at the end.
